title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Requests for Instructions and Replies on Issues Concerning the Application of Law
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Request for Instructions and Reply on Legal Application Issues

Fa [2023] No. 88

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Request for Instructions and Reply on Legal Application Issues are hereby issued for your earnest implementation. Any circumstances or problems encountered during implementation shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court.

May 26, 2023

Supreme People's Court

Provisions on Request for Instructions and Reply on Legal Application Issues

I. General Provisions

Article 1 To regulate the work of the people's courts in requesting instructions and replying on legal application issues, strengthen supervision and guidance of trials, and enhance judicial fairness and efficiency, these Provisions are formulated in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and judicial interpretations and in light of the actual circumstances of trial work.

Article 2 A High People's Court may submit a request for instructions to the Supreme People's Court under any of the following circumstances:

(1) There are no clear provisions in laws, regulations, judicial interpretations, or normative documents, and there is a major dispute over the application of the law;

(2) There is a major dispute over the understanding of the specific meaning of provisions in laws, regulations, judicial interpretations, or normative documents;

(3) The objective circumstances on which the judicial interpretation or normative document was based when formulated have undergone significant changes, and continuing to apply the relevant provisions is obviously contrary to fairness and justice;

(4) The judgment rules in similar cases are obviously inconsistent;

(5) There are other major disputes over the application of the law.

For issues concerning the application of law in technical intellectual property and antitrust cases, a court of first instance may submit a request for instructions to the Supreme People's Court if any of the circumstances specified in the preceding paragraph exists.

Where the Supreme People's Court deems it necessary, it may require a lower people's court to report the relevant circumstances.

Article 3 A request for instructions shall not be made on issues of fact-finding in a case.

II. Request for Instructions

Article 4 To submit a request for instructions to the Supreme People's Court, the judicial committee of the court requesting the instructions shall, through discussion and decision, provide an opinion on the legal application issue and state the reasons; if there are divergent opinions, the predominant opinion shall be set forth.

Article 5 A request for instructions shall be submitted level by level according to the trial level.

Article 6 The people's court submitting a request for instructions shall produce a written request in the name of the court, briefly stating the legal application issue for which instructions are requested, and shall produce a comprehensive report on the request, setting forth the following:

(1) The legal application issue for which instructions are requested and the origin thereof;

(2) The discussion situation at the collegial panel and the judicial committee regarding the legal application issue for which instructions are requested, any divergent opinions, and the respective reasons;

(3) The results of similar case searches;

(4) Other circumstances that need to be reported;

(5) The contact person and contact information.

Where a High People's Court submits a request for instructions to the Supreme People's Court regarding a legal application issue raised by a basic or intermediate people's court, it shall also attach the comprehensive report on the request from the lower people's court.

The request and the comprehensive report on the request, each in five copies, together with the electronic version, shall be submitted to the Case Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court.

III. Handling

Article 7 The Case Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court shall complete the review within three working days from the date of receipt of the request materials. If the request materials meet the requirements, a case number shall be assigned and the following handling shall be carried out according to the circumstances:

(1) If the request falls within the scope of matters and procedures for which instructions may be requested, it shall be accepted and the department responsible for handling the request shall be determined;

(2) If the request does not fall within the scope of such matters or violates the relevant procedures, it shall not be accepted, and the people's court that submitted the request shall be notified in writing.

If the request materials do not meet the requirements, the people's court that submitted the request shall be informed at once of the deficiencies and given a specified time limit to supplement them.

Article 8 The Case Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court shall determine the department responsible for handling the request in accordance with the following provisions:

(1) If the legal application issue for which instructions are requested concerns the specific meaning of provisions in judicial interpretations or normative documents, or falls within the category of similar issues addressed by judicial interpretations or normative documents, it shall be handled by the drafting department; if there are multiple drafting departments, it shall be handled by the principal drafting department;

(2) If the circumstances in the preceding paragraph do not apply, the department responsible for handling the request shall be determined according to the division of functions and responsibilities.

If the responsible department is difficult to determine, the Case Filing Division shall determine it jointly with the Research Office.

Article 9 After receiving the request materials transferred by the Case Filing Division, if the responsible department considers, upon review, that the matter does not fall within its purview, it shall, within three working days, negotiate with the Case Filing Division for return; if no agreement is reached, it shall, after obtaining approval from the executive judge in charge, return the materials to the Case Filing Division for reallocation. The departments concerned shall not transfer or refer the matter on their own.

If another department considers that the request should be handled by itself, it shall, after reporting to and obtaining approval from the executive judge in charge, submit its opinion to the Case Filing Division.

Article 10 The responsible department shall designate a specific person to handle the request. After the handler studies and proposes a handling opinion, the responsible department shall organize collective deliberation.

With respect to the legal application issue for which instructions are requested, the responsible department may consult with other relevant departments within the court for joint study, or after drafting a preliminary handling opinion, seek the opinions of relevant departments within the court. Where necessary, opinions may also be sought from relevant departments outside the court or from experts.

Article 11 The responsible department shall submit the handling opinion to the executive judge in charge for approval. Where necessary, the executive judge in charge may submit the matter to the President for approval or request that it be placed before the Judicial Committee for discussion and decision.

Before submitting to the executive judge in charge for approval, the responsible department shall send the handling opinion to the Research Office for review. The Research Office shall generally issue a review opinion within five working days. If the Research Office raises a different opinion, the responsible department shall provide an explanation when submitting the matter to the executive judge in charge for approval.

Article 12 The Supreme People's Court shall handle the matter in accordance with the following circumstances:

(1) Provide a clear reply to the legal application issue for which instructions were requested and state the basis for the reply;

(2) If the request does not fall within the scope of matters for which instructions may be requested, or violates the relevant procedures, no reply shall be given, and the people's court that submitted the request shall be notified in writing;

(3) If the Supreme People's Court has already given a reply on the same or similar legal application issue, it may choose not to reply again and shall inform the people's court that submitted the request of the relevant circumstances.

Article 13 The reply of the Supreme People's Court shall be made in the name of the court.

Replies shall generally be in writing. If a reply is made by telephone or other means, the draft and other materials shall be retained for future reference.

After the reply is made, the responsible department shall promptly upload it to the inquiry database.

Article 14 The Supreme People's Court shall handle a request for instructions as expeditiously as possible and shall complete the handling within two months from the date of acceptance of the request. If it is necessary to seek the opinions of relevant departments outside the court or to submit the matter to the Judicial Committee for discussion, the time limit may be extended by two months.

If, for special reasons, the handling cannot be completed within the time limit specified in the preceding paragraph, the responsible department shall, after reporting to the executive judge in charge, promptly notify the people's court that submitted the request and send a copy to the Trial Management Office.

For requests for instructions concerning criminal legal application issues, where necessary, the relevant people's court may be reminded to lawfully change compulsory measures.

Article 15 The people's court that submitted the request for instructions shall comply with the reply of the Supreme People's Court, but shall not cite it as a basis for the judgment.

Article 16 For replies that may be made public, the Supreme People's Court shall publish them to the public through appropriate means.

IV. Other Provisions

Article 17 The Supreme People's Court assigns a case number to the handling of each request for instructions and reply, with the type code being "Fa Fu".

Article 18 During the handling of a request for instructions and reply, if the Supreme People's Court considers that the legal application issue for which instructions are requested is of a general nature, representative, and particularly significant in impact, it may notify the lower people's court to lawfully transfer the relevant case to the Supreme People's Court for trial.

Article 19 If the legal application issue addressed in the reply has general guiding significance, the people's court that submitted the request for instructions may compile a case and recommend it as a candidate guiding case to the Supreme People's Court.

Article 20 For the legal application issue for which instructions were requested, the Supreme People's Court may, where necessary, formulate a judicial interpretation to provide clarification.

Article 21 The Supreme People's Court shall establish a dedicated module for handling requests for instructions and replies and an inquiry database, to carry out information-based handling, intelligent management, and digital analysis and application of requests for instructions and replies.

The Trial Management Office shall be responsible for the process management, quality assessment, and other matters related to requests for instructions and replies.

If the responsible department fails to complete the handling within the time limit specified in Article 14 of these Provisions, the Trial Management Office shall require the responsible department to provide a written explanation, urge it to complete the handling within a prescribed period, and, as appropriate, issue a notice regarding the matter.

Article 22 The submission and handling of requests for instructions, and related work, shall comply with the relevant provisions on confidentiality.

Article 23 Where a basic or intermediate people's court submits a request for instructions on a legal application issue, and an intermediate or high people's court handles the legal application issue, these Provisions shall apply mutatis mutandis.

Article 24 Each High People's Court and the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army shall, before January 31 of each year, submit the replies made by that court in the preceding year to the Research Office of the Supreme People's Court.

Article 25 These Provisions shall take effect on September 1, 2023. Where any previous normative document is inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.

Annex: Reference Formats for Documents

Annex: Reference Formats for Documents

Reference Format 1: Request for Instructions

XXX High People's Court

Request for Instructions on the Legal Application Issue of XXX

X Gao Fa Qing [Year] XX

Supreme People's Court:

Our court (or XXX People's Court), in the course of hearing (or enforcing) the case of XXX (state the names of the parties and the cause of action), has encountered a major dispute over the legal application issue of XXX. After discussion, the Judicial Committee of our court considered (or was inclined to consider) that ... (briefly state the opinion or inclination of the Judicial Committee on the legal application issue and the corresponding reasons). In accordance with the provisions of Item XX of Paragraph 1 of Article 2 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Request for Instructions and Reply on Legal Application Issues, we hereby submit a request for instructions to your court. Please give a reply.

XX Month XX Day, XXXX

(Court Seal)

Contact person and contact information:

[Note] (1) This format is for use when a High People's Court submits a request for instructions to the Supreme People's Court. Courts of first instance in technical intellectual property and monopoly cases submitting requests for instructions to the Supreme People's Court shall apply this format mutatis mutandis.

(2) If the request for instructions concerns issues reflected in a category of cases, the phrase "in the course of hearing (or enforcing) the case of XXX (state the names of the parties and the cause of action)" shall be modified to "in the course of hearing (or enforcing) cases."

Reference Format 2: Comprehensive Report on the Request for Instructions

XXX High People's Court

Comprehensive Report on the Request for Instructions on the Legal Application Issue of XXX

Supreme People's Court:

Our court (or XXX People's Court), in the course of hearing (or enforcing) the case of XXX (state the names of the parties and the cause of action), has encountered a major dispute over the legal application issue of XXX. After discussion by the Judicial Committee of our court, in accordance with the provisions of Item XX of Paragraph 1 of Article 2 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Request for Instructions and Reply on Legal Application Issues, we submit a request for instructions to your court. The relevant circumstances are comprehensively reported as follows:

I. The Legal Application Issue for Which Instructions Are Requested and the Origin Thereof

... (Here, mainly state the legal application issue for which instructions are requested. Where necessary, the relevant facts may be set forth around the legal application issue for which instructions are requested.)

II. Opinions of the Collegial Panel and the Judicial Committee on the Legal Application Issue for Which Instructions Are Requested

... (Here, state in detail the opinions, basis, and reasons of the collegial panel and the Judicial Committee on the legal application issue for which instructions are requested; if there are differing opinions, they shall also be stated.)

III. Similar Case Search Results

... (Here, state the results of the similar case search conducted in accordance with the Guiding Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Unifying Legal Application and Strengthening Similar Case Searches (Trial), with emphasis on the search results for guiding cases, typical cases, and cases with effective judgments published by the Supreme People's Court.)

IV. Other Circumstances That Need to Be Reported

... (Here, state circumstances that may have an impact on the legal application.)

XX Month XX Day, XXXX

(Court Seal)

Contact person and contact information:

[Note] (1) This format is for use when a High People's Court submits a request for instructions to the Supreme People's Court. Courts of first instance in technical intellectual property and monopoly cases submitting requests for instructions to the Supreme People's Court shall apply this format mutatis mutandis.

(2) If the request for instructions concerns issues reflected in a category of cases, the phrase "in the course of hearing (or enforcing) the case of XXX (state the names of the parties and the cause of action)" in the first paragraph of the main text shall be modified to "in the course of hearing (or enforcing) cases."

Reference Format 3: Reply

Supreme People's Court

Reply on the Request for Instructions on the Legal Application Issue of XXX

(XXXX) Zui Gao Fa Fu XXXX

XXX High People's Court:

We have received your court's request for instructions on the legal application issue of XXX (X Gao Fa Qing [Year] XX). Upon review, in accordance with the provisions of Item 1 of Article 12 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Request for Instructions and Reply on Legal Application Issues, we hereby reply as follows:

In accordance with the provisions of Article XX of the XXX (state the basis of the reply), ... (state the specific content of the reply).

This is a reply.

XX Month XX Day, XXXX

(Court Seal)

[Note] This format is for use when the Supreme People's Court gives a reply to a request for instructions from a High People's Court. When the Supreme People's Court gives a reply to a request for instructions from a court of first instance in a technical intellectual property or monopoly case, this format shall apply mutatis mutandis.

Reference Format 4: Notice of Non-Acceptance

Supreme People's Court

Notice of Non-Acceptance of the Request for Instructions on the Legal Application Issue of XXX

(XXXX) Zui Gao Fa Fu XXXX

XXX High People's Court:

We have received your court's request for instructions on the legal application issue of XXX (X Gao Fa Qing [Year] XX). Upon review, because ... (state the reason for non-acceptance), in accordance with the provisions of Item 2 of Paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Request for Instructions and Reply on Legal Application Issues, the request is not accepted.

This is a notice.

XX Month XX Day, XXXX

(Court Seal)

[Note] This format is for use when the Supreme People's Court does not accept a request for instructions from a High People's Court. When the Supreme People's Court does not accept a request for instructions from a court of first instance in a technical intellectual property or monopoly case, this format shall apply mutatis mutandis.

Reference Format 5: Notice of No Reply

Supreme People's Court

Notice of No Reply on the Request for Instructions on the Legal Application Issue of XXX

(XXXX) Zui Gao Fa Fu XXXX

XXX High People's Court:

We have received your court's request for instructions on the legal application issue of XXX (X Gao Fa Qing [Year] XX). Upon review, because ... (briefly state the reason for not replying; if the Supreme People's Court has previously given a reply on the same or similar legal application issue, the content of that previous reply may be stated and the reply attached), in accordance with the provisions of Item 2 (or Item 3) of Article 12 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Request for Instructions and Reply on Legal Application Issues, no reply will be given.

This is a notice.

XX Month XX Day, XXXX

(Court Seal)

[Note] This format is for use when the Supreme People's Court gives no reply to a request for instructions from a High People's Court. When the Supreme People's Court gives no reply to a request for instructions from a court of first instance in a technical intellectual property or monopoly case, this format shall apply mutatis mutandis.
